fact: The SADC observation mission noted the IEC refused to provide an electronic copy of the electoral roll during inspection and verification for the 30 October 2024 elections, only hard copies being available, and the High Court dismissed a bid to compel it on 29 October 2024.
title: Preliminary Statement by the Head of the SADC Electoral Observation Mission to the 30 October 2024 General Elections in Botswana
